mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, topic, tag, msg_key AS msgKey, payload_json AS payloadJson, attempts, last_error AS lastError, create_at AS createAt, sent_at AS sentAt FROM sys_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_outbox SET sent_at = #{sentAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND sent_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL AND sent_at < #{before}
